releaseLaw: One profile holds exactly one engine release. Only a resolved version equal to the exact ratified pin activates its profile. releaseLine is descriptive metadata, never an admission range. Every other version, including a different patch in the same line, is unsupported-version and is never coerced. A newly ratified release needs a distinct release and profile identity.

releases.role: template host: its ERB handler compiles every Action View template

profiles.selectedWhen: the package's Gemfile.lock resolves actionview 8.1.4 and erubi 1.13.1, or (without actionview) resolves erubi 1.13.1, or an explicit on names this profile

tags.note: the - indicator is handled exactly like <%

tags.emits: the tag text with its first % removed

trimModes.rule: a code tag (with or without -) or a comment tag preceded only by spaces or tabs on its line and immediately followed by optional spaces or tabs and a newline drops that leading whitespace and the trailing spaces or tabs and newline; at EOF without that newline, leading whitespace is preserved

trimModes.actionViewSetting: erb_trim_mode set to any other value

profiles.closeRule: first-%>: the tag body is the shortest run up to the first %>, whatever Ruby string or comment it is inside
profiles.percentPercentClose: not recognised: %%> ends the tag at its %>, and the extra % stays in the tag body

escaping.actionView: <%= is HTML-escaped through the output buffer and <%== is raw; templates of type text/plain (escape_ignore_list) make both forms raw
escaping.standaloneErubi: escape is an application option Verter cannot read: <%= versus <%== escaping is unknown

profiles.encodingTag: a leading <%# encoding: ... %> comment is removed by Action View before compilation

profiles.hostRelation: Action View 8.1 does not compile templates with this engine; the profile is selected only when the lockfile resolves erb and neither actionview nor erubi, or an explicit on names it
profiles.selectedWhen: the package's Gemfile.lock resolves erb 6.0.7 and resolves neither actionview nor erubi, or an explicit on names this profile
unrecognised: <%== is not a tag: it scans as <%= followed by a code byte =
<%- and -%> are tag delimiters only under trim modes - and %-

trimModes.rule: a line starting with % is a code line; %% at line start is a literal %
omit the newline of each line starting with <% and ending with %>
omit the newline of each line ending with %>
<%- and -%> trim; omit each blank line ending with -%>

profiles.trimModeSource: the trim mode is a constructor argument chosen by the calling code; Verter never reads it from Ruby. Without configuration it is unknown, never guessed; how a mode-dependent construct (a leading %, <%-, -%>) scans while the mode is unknown is ERB1's to fix against this profile
profiles.closeRule: first-%>: the tag body is the shortest run up to the first %> (or the mode's -%>), whatever Ruby string or comment it is inside
profiles.percentPercentClose: %%> inside a tag is a literal %> and does not close it
profiles.percentLines: only under a trim mode containing %
profiles.escaping: <%= is never escaped by the engine

nextMajor.rule: A next major of actionview, erubi or erb becomes a second profile only after it is announced and ratified in this lock; until then it is unsupported-version.

excluded.reason: a lockfile records exact resolved versions; a range, latest or a Gemfile requirement is never a release

opaqueHelpers.rule: its helpers (turbo_frame_tag, turbo_stream, ...) are opaque Ruby calls inside an island
its helpers are opaque Ruby calls inside an island

toolOracle: none: official sources are the conformance truth; no Ruby, Bundler or gem process runs in CI or at runtime
notes: Pins are the starting pins ratified by the ERB0 charter. The executable rejection of floating, latest, prerelease and Rails 7.x rows is ERB1G-ACV (tests/framework-erb/ERB0/cases.md lists every planted row).
